relationships.subject: SphK/S1P/S1PR1 axis
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicate that the SphK/SIP/S1PR1 axis regulates the expression of NLRP3, Caspase-1, IL-1β, IL-18 and ROS in the spinal dorsal horn to mediate remifentanil-induced hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: we observed that suppressing NLRP3 or ROS signal attenuated the mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia induced by remifentanil

relationships.subject: SphK/S1P/S1PR1 axis
relationships.evidence_quote: By blocking the SphK/S1P/S1PR1 axis, remifentanil-induced hyperalgesia was reduced

key_findings: Remifentanil upregulates the SphK/S1P/S1PR1 axis (S1PR1 in astrocytes), driving NLRP3, caspase-1, IL-1β, IL-18 and ROS in the spinal dorsal horn and hyperalgesia.
